comment: Each of the seven knobs has its own attenuverter and CV jack directly below it, so the seven attenuverters share one line; the pitch attenuverter is the one configured fully open so a cable in the pitch jack tracks one volt per octave with nothing to set up. The mode and range CV jacks override their switches while patched rather than adding to them. The engine runs at the fundamental times the power of two nearest twice the host rate, re-chosen only when the fundamental moves more than a semitone, with a zero-order hold back down to the host rate; that is what keeps the aliasing tuned to the note. The panel prints tundo, pitch, harm, spread, morph, fold, attack, decay, mode, range, hit, cv twice, trig, audio and env.
